prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Silvia, who is cautious about neighborhood rumors but sometimes believes them.
Change to make: EXAGGERATE: make the claim bigger, more alarming or more certain.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "The council is officially launching a massive crackdown to hunt down anyone with a bin out past 8am. They’re finally imposing their extreme new control measures on every single one of us!"
text: The council is deploying a massive surveillance team to aggressively hunt down and fine absolutely everyone who leaves their bin out past 8am. They are officially launching an extreme, total crackdown that will target every single household in the neighborhood without exception!
